result.justification: The objectives are addressed in the context of an acute pancreatitis case related to HAV infection, but the methodology lacks details on sample size and controls.

evidence.quote: This case underscores acute pancreatitis as a rare but important extrahepatic manifestation of HAV infection.
Abdominal ultrasonography demonstrated hepatomegaly with an enlarged, edematous pancreas and no gallstones or biliary obstruction.
